bindings.title: Rebuild the Google Sheets node "Record Rejected Input"
bindings.detail: This node is typed as Google Sheets but carries "databaseId", which is not a parameter that node has - it belongs to a different n8n node. The node will import, show none of these fields, and do nothing useful. Replace it with the node the parameters imply, or with a Google Sheets node configured from scratch. This is a defect in the template; tell us and we will fix or refund it.

bindings.title: Import "lib: Post-Process Tickets" and select it on Offload to Post-Process Sub-workflow
bindings.detail: This template calls a separate workflow named lib: Post-Process Tickets, and it is included in your download as lib/lib-post-process-tickets.json. Import that file into n8n first (Workflows -> Import from File), then open Offload to Post-Process Sub-workflow and pick it in the workflowId selector. The selector is empty until you do: a workflow id only exists inside your own instance, so it cannot be set for you.

bindings.title: Select the Google Sheets documentId
bindings.detail: The dropdown shows "Ticket Tracker", which is a placeholder label with no value behind it - the node looks configured and is not. Open each of: Park in Dead-Letter Queue, Store as P1, Store as P2, Store as P3 and pick the real documentId from the list.

bindings.title: Select the Notion databaseId
bindings.detail: The dropdown shows "Ticket Database", which is a placeholder label with no value behind it - the node looks configured and is not. Open each of: Append Audit Row (Notion), Archive Row Snapshot, Load Previous Snapshot and pick the real databaseId from the list.

behaviour.title: Point the HTTP calls at your own endpoint
behaviour.detail: The URL "enrichment.example.com" is illustrative - example.com is reserved for documentation and resolves to nothing useful. Replace it with the service you are actually calling, and set that service's authentication on the node.

behaviour.title: Clear the pinned sample data before going live
behaviour.detail: "Receive Inbound Webhook" carries pinned sample data, which is what lets the workflow run end to end before you have wired anything up. While it is pinned, a manual execution reads the sample and never calls the real service - so the run succeeds and proves nothing about your setup. Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.
